description: A folder as every command that returns one returns it.

id.description: null for /, and for a folder with no usable folder file.

dir.description: The absolute filesystem path of the folder's directory.

blocked_by.description: Its folder file's; [] for /; null for a folder with no usable folder file.

notes_path.description: The absolute filesystem path of the folder's @folder.md; null for /.

readiness.description: done when every task under it, at any depth, is done; else blocked or ready by its own and inherited blockers. / is never blocked.

open_blockers.description: The IDs that block its contents now, in its own blocked_by and those of the folders above it. Ascending.

empty.description: Whether it holds no task file at any depth, usable or not. An empty folder is done.

partial.description: A folder cut down by `fields`: id, path, and the fields asked for.
